figurative_meaning_en: A woman in the full bloom of youth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটি ভরযুবতী যুবতী, যার সৌন্দর্য সকলকে মুগ্ধ করে।
লোকগানে ভরযুবতী নারীর কথা প্রায়ই উল্লেখিত হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a woman in the full bloom of youth, captivating everyone with her beauty.
Folk songs often mention the bharyuboti woman.
history: Derived from Bengali folk songs (lokgeeti), evoking images of youthful feminine allure in rural traditions.
note: This term is poetic and rooted in oral literature, emphasizing vitality and attractiveness.
